baby_development: The neural tube, heart, and digestive system are forming.
mother_symptoms: Nausea (morning sickness), fatigue, tender breasts, frequent urination.
diet_advice: Take prenatal vitamins with folic acid. Eat small, frequent meals. Stay hydrated. Avoid alcohol, smoking, and raw or undercooked food.
warning_signs: Severe abdominal pain, heavy bleeding, extreme dizziness, fainting.
